Hi Soojin —

Quick intro: I work at Orchid Recruiting and I'm handing over a candidate that looks like a strong match for the Sr ML Engineer role on your infra/serving team. Candidate: Pablo Velasquez (pablo.velasquez@gmail.com).

Why I’m passing him to you now:
- 7+ years building production ML infra (pytorch, CUDA kernels)
- Led model-serving optimizations at his current startup (reduced token latency by 18%)
- Open to relocation or remote within US, available to start in ~4–6 weeks

Attached is his CV (CV_Pablo_Velasquez.pdf). He’s happy to do a quick phone screen first; I can coordinate. Pablo has requested that we keep his current employer confidential until a later stage.

Can you confirm who on your side should do the initial phone screen and provide 2–3 windows? Happy to coordinate calendar invites.

Thanks —

sofia@orchidrecruiting.com

- Confirm right to work and target start date (he mentioned 4–6 weeks — is that firm?)
- Any counter-offer risk / notice period specifics

Quick notes from a 30-min phone screen with Pablo (recording saved to internal folder; see attachment stub phone_screen_notes_20261116.txt):

Positive:
- Strong practical knowledge of KV caching patterns and batching logic used for inference; gave concrete examples of reducing wasted compute in prefix-heavy workloads.
- Experience with quantization-aware inference pipelines and some hands-on with custom CUDA kernels (small PRs at previous employer).
- Good communication, clear tradeoff thinking, and senior ownership examples.

Concerns / follow-ups:
- Limited exposure to distributed inference across multi-node clusters at >100RPS (he’s mostly optimized single-GPU throughput).
- Wants clarity on SLO ownership and on-call expectations — flagged this as a potential negotiate point.

Recommendation: Move to an on-site loop (or multi-interviewer virtual loop) focused on systems scaling + production runbook discussion. Compensation expectation: asked about band — Sofia, can you confirm target comp band for this role with Pablo?

—Karthik
Staff ML Engineer (Interview)
Attachment: phone_screen_notes_20261116.txt (note: internal summary, 1.2 KB)

Thanks Karthik — good notes and thanks for the quick turnaround.

Sofia — based on the phone screen we’d like to move Pablo to the loop stage. Please confirm these items so we can finalize scheduling:
1) Compensation band expectation (Pablo asked for a range; we need his target and flexibility).
2) Confirmation he’s okay with an on-site loop (we will cover travel) or if he prefers a full-day virtual loop.
3) Any non-comp constraints (equity preferences, relocation requirements, or counter-offer probability).

Ava — once Sofia confirms comp and availability, please kick off calendar invites for the following interviewers (suggested slots next week): Karthik (systems scaling), Ava (hiring manager / product fit), and an SRE (TBD). We’ll include a 60–90 min loop with a 30-min runbook/deploy discussion.

Sofia — also please send Pablo the candidate prep doc (short, what to expect) and copy me on the outreach so we can keep the loop confidential.

Thanks —
